en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a large cathedral with vaulted ceilings, ornate arches, frescoes, and an elaborate high altar approached by several stairways. At the bottom left of the front image is a printed caption. The reverse side shows typical postcard layout with Hungarian text, a Hungarian stamp, postmark, address lines, and handwritten message.
